title: FancyWorlds
description: Simple, lightweight and fast world management plugin
body:
![FancyWorlds Banner](https://fancyinnovations.com/logos-and-banners/fancyworlds-banner.png)
Simple, lightweight and fast world management plugin for **[Paper](https://papermc.io/software/paper)** servers.
_This plugin requires the [FancyDialogs](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fancydialogs) plugin to work. So make sure to have both FancyDialogs and FancyWorlds installed._ ## Features - Create, clone and delete worlds - Load and unload worlds - Use custom world generators - Change world properties (time, gamerules, ...) - Many placeholders (PlaceholderAPI) ## Planned Features - Pre generate worlds - Create world templates - World portals - Take snapshots of worlds (Git but for worlds) - Many placeholders (PlaceholderAPI) ## Data collection This plugin collects anonymous usage data to help us understand how the plugin is being used and to improve it. All collected data by all servers is aggregated, we don't store any IP addresses, server names, or any other information that could be used to identify a specific server or user. Read more about that topic (used platforms, how to opt-out, list of metrics ...) in the [documentation](https://fancyinnovations.com/docs/minecraft-plugins/data-collection).
